name: Indigo Zidane-Fredriksen
role: Barber and hair sculptor, runs a one-chair shop in Hamtramck Enclave
location: Hamtramck Enclave — her shop, Vásárhelyi's Cut, is wedged between a noodle stand and a bootleg geneware parlor on Tessera Row, near Western and Division
description:
Remi is a broad-shouldered woman with close-cropped silver hair she keeps so geometric it looks machined. Her hands are her livelihood and her pride — steady, scarred at the knuckles, with two fingers on her left hand replaced by matte-black prosthetic digits that give her razor work an inhuman precision. She has warm brown skin mapped with pale keloid lines along her forearms from a factory accident twenty years ago, and her eyes are naturally deep amber, though she's added cosmetic irises that bloom like sunflowers when she's in good humor. She wears the same style every day: clean work apron, sleeves rolled, a small copper pendant of Ogun that she touches before every haircut.

Remi has the gravitational pull of a person who has simply been somewhere long enough that the neighborhood bends around her. She remembers who your grandmother was, who owes who, and which corponation rep came through last month asking questions they shouldn't ask. She is unhurried, deliberate, and precise — in speech as in blade work — and she has a talent for making people say things in the chair they didn't mean to say out loud. She is not unkind. She is practical in the way of someone who has survived enough to stop being romantic about it.

core_fears: Losing the shop — the one thing she built that is entirely hers
Becoming irrelevant to a neighborhood that is changing faster than she can track
core_desires: To be of genuine use to the people around her
To leave Tessera Row better than she found it
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the morning incense, the precise sweep of the floor, the order of her tools
Humor deployed just before emotion becomes visible
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people fear her opinion of them
Assumes loyalty is as uncomplicated for others as it is for her
psychology.secret: Twenty-two years ago she testified against her former employer, a small Axiom subcontractor, in a labor dispute. Her testimony was accurate. Three coworkers lost their jobs anyway, and one of them — a man named Boubacar — died homeless two winters later. She has never told anyone she blames herself, and she pays for Boubacar's daughter's school fees anonymously every month.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich, unhurried, code-switches fluidly between English and Yoruba phrases; uses West African proverbs without irony or explanation
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and measured, as if she has decided each word before opening her mouth
verbal_tics: 'You hear me?' at the end of significant statements
Clicks her prosthetic fingers once when thinking
example_lines: 'Sit. I will tell you what I know, but first you are going to look like a person again.'
'The tree does not move because the bird lands on it. That man is not as important as he believes.'

story_hooks: A young person whose family Remi has known for two generations comes in — they're in serious debt and too ashamed to tell their parents. Remi will not solve it for them, but she might know who to send them to.
Someone has been asking around Tessera Row about Remi specifically, claiming to be a relative from Lagos. Remi has no living relatives from Lagos.
narrative_function: Information nexus and community anchor — she knows everyone on the block and most of their secrets. Excellent quest giver for neighborhood-level problems. Can serve as mentor, confidante, or the person who tells a protagonist an uncomfortable truth while they're stuck in the chair.
augmentations: Two prosthetic fingers (left hand, high-precision, matte black polymer); cosmetic sunflower-pattern irises. No geneware.
daily_life: Opens the shop at 0700, works until her back says otherwise, usually around 2100. Sweeps the floor herself. Burns a data-offering incense stick to the E.L.F. she calls Grandmother Clippers every morning.
affiliation: Independent; informal community elder of Tessera Row, Hamtramck Enclave

decision_rules: Never give information that gets someone hurt without understanding the risk first
Handle neighborhood business inside the neighborhood if at all possible
escalation_ladder: Silence and a very level look
Asking the person to leave the chair

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, observing carefully, asks more questions than she answers
interpersonal_modes.friends: Direct, generous, occasionally brutal with the truth because she respects them enough

stress_responses.low: Becomes quieter, works with more deliberate care
stress_responses.medium: Closes the shop early, sits in the back with the lights off
stress_responses.high: Calls in a favor she's been holding a long time — she has a few

contradictions: Believes deeply in community self-determination but sometimes makes decisions for people 'for their own good'
habits: Touches the Ogun pendant before starting a haircut
Memorizes new customers' faces in three segments — forehead, eyes, jaw — before speaking to them
breaking_points: Harm to children in the enclave
Someone using her shop as a venue for violence

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave to a Hungarian-Malian household
Apprenticed to a barber on Tessera Row after the factory accident that cost her two fingers
Testified against Axiom subcontractor in the Hamtramck Labor Hearings; Boubacar dies two years later
Opened Vásárhelyi's Cut on the same block she was born on

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Carrion Defense Works Entropic Shotgun ES-4 'Ragnarok'

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian (41.6%) with significant North African (18.9%), Southeast Asian (17.9%), and Sub-Saharan African (15.0%) ancestry, with minor East Asian (6.6%) heritage. A striking genetic blend from the Ubiquitous Diaspora creating unique phenotypic features across multiple continental lineages.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid, muscular through the arms and back from decades of precision blade work. Carries weight with the settled confidence of someone past the age of proving anything to anyone.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped with geometric precision — lines sharp enough to suggest machine work, maintained with ritualistic care
physical_description.eye_color: Deep amber (natural), with cosmetic sunflower-pattern irises that appear to bloom/shift with mood and light
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep warm bronze with complex undertones — the Central Asian and North African heritage creates golden-warm base tones, enriched by the Sub-Saharan and Southeast Asian components into a nuanced, sun-responsive complexion
physical_description.complexion: Weathered in the specific way of someone who has worked under bright task lighting for five decades. The multi-continental heritage creates subtle variations in skin texture and tone distribution across the face. Minimal makeup. Laugh lines around the eyes and mouth suggest frequent, genuine amusement. Skin condition is clean and well-maintained, grooming meticulous.
distinguishing_marks: Pale keloid scarring mapping both forearms in organic linear patterns — legacy of factory accident approximately twenty years prior
Knuckle scars on both hands — decades of precision work and minor cuts from blade discipline
Small surgical scars at the base of the left hand where prosthetic fingers interface with remaining bone and tissue
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left hand, ring and pinky fingers replaced with matte-black polymer prosthetics — high-precision engineering with articulated joints. The prosthetics are deliberately visible, unmarked by chrome shine or aesthetic fakery. Cosmetic iris implants with sunflower-pattern pigmentation that shifts subtly with pupil dilation and emotional state.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders back but not rigid. Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion. Hands move with the precision of someone who has spent 50 years handling sharp tools; even idle hand movements have a quality of controlled grace. Her gaze is steady and unhurried. When listening, she is still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Consistent daily uniform: Heavy-duty canvas work apron (cream or pale grey, always clean), sleeves of whatever shirt she wears underneath rolled precisely to the elbow. Practical Tier 3 workwear — durable, functional, no corporate branding. Copper pendant of Ogun worn on a simple cord, touched before each cut as ritual. Comfortable work shoes, worn but maintained. No jewelry beyond the pendant and a single thin wedding band (worn on right hand).
